steps.title: Provision the runtime secret through Keychain or a device-local secret file; do not embed the secret in MDM profile content.
steps.evidence: Doctor report shows runtime_secret_source=file or keychain.

steps.title: Generate or distribute Agent Config from MDM Managed App Config and confirm tenant/device/user IDs.
steps.expected: Agent Config exists; runtime_secret and runtime_secret_file are redacted in any shared copy.

steps.title: Review the protected app map that will drive proxy-based steering.
steps.expected: Protected FQDNs and application IDs match the PoC target set.

steps.title: For the macOS proxy-based PoC path, install or inspect the generated PAC file for protected FQDN routing.
steps.expected: PAC returns the local proxy for protected FQDNs and DIRECT otherwise.

steps.title: Inspect the guarded macOS System Proxy helper before applying PAC settings to a test network service.
steps.expected: Script defaults to status mode, plan output shows guarded apply/rollback commands, and apply or rollback requires DSSE_APPLY_SYSTEM_PROXY=true.

steps.title: Install the generated launchd plist with the expected binary path and config path.
steps.expected: plist syntax is valid and ProgramArguments contains -config.

steps.title: Install or update the Windows Service wrapper for the Local Client.
steps.expected: PowerShell script contains New-Service and -config; no runtime secret marker.

steps.title: Run Local Client doctor before connecting to Edge.
steps.expected: status is ok or warning; failed is not acceptable.

steps.title: After one Local Client run, verify the local cache without contacting Edge.
On a macOS test device, apply the guarded System Proxy PAC and verify that System Proxy-originated traffic increments localproxy steering metrics.
steps.expected: Verifier status is ok; request_command uses macos_system_proxy_request.py; steering_attempted and steering_succeeded are greater than zero.

steps.title: Check the Edge Agent Quality summary for the test tenant.
Create and verify the Support Bundle after collecting real-device evidence. When macOS System Proxy smoke was run, include its report directory.
steps.expected: Support Bundle verifier status is ok; cache_verified is true; source dirs are redacted. For macOS System Proxy PoC, verifier reports macos_system_proxy_steering_smoke_status=ok and macos_system_proxy_steering_smoke_verified=true.

steps.title: Share the Agent Lab artifact archive rather than raw local working directories.
steps.expected: Public report uses basenames only and contains no local absolute paths.

steps.title: Remove the launchd job with the generated uninstall helper after collecting evidence.
steps.expected: Script contains launchctl and no runtime secret marker.

steps.title: Remove the Windows Service wrapper with the generated uninstall helper after collecting evidence.
steps.expected: Script contains sc.exe delete and no runtime secret marker.
